name: Penny Ann's Famous "Heavenly Hotcakes" with Warm Syrup
whyItWorks: Award-winning light, fluffy sour cream pancakes. The cultured sour cream in the batter creates an exceptionally tender crumb that dissolves quickly in the stomach without tough fiber or heavy grease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy with warm maple or pancake syrup. Order butter on the side and skip side bacon or sausage if fat-sensitive.
